title: Reasonable dreams
content: I hear about people dreaming about random stuff or about things that have some symbolic meaning. My dreams are usually very logical and reasonable. In my dreams- I can practically solve a problem that I was stuck during the day or find errors in my work that I did during the day. All this while I am aware that I am dreaming. When I wake up sometimes I remember complete dreams and other times part of it. Am I the only one who has this?
